title: FY Ceramic Vase Porcelain Vase Modern Scandinavian minimalist Design Pasu Seramik Pasu Bunga Bekas Bunga Flower Pot
description:
FY Ceramic Vase Porcelain Vase Modern Scandinavian minimalist Design Pasu Seramik Pasu Bunga Bekas Bunga Flower Pot
ATTENTION :
Pls Kindly check all the measurements of the vase before add to cart.
If possible refer to the ruler or measurement tape, NEVER try to imagine the size!!
Handmade Ceramic vase, if you expect 100% zero defect, PLS DONT ADD TO CART !!!

Size: Click for each variant and check for the size respectively
Material: Ceramic

【MINIMALIST TEXTURE VASE】: Scandinavian minimalist style, elegant design and texture color glazed surface reflect the unique style of Chinese porcelain. This vase adds an artistic flavor to your home or office. Provides both decorative and functional purposes: Fill with a fresh bouquet of real or artificial flowers when used as a centerpiece or leave empty when used for display on shelves, coffee tables, fireplaces or high surfaces.

【VERSATILE】: Ideal for office or home decoration, dinner parties, wedding planning, and other special occasions, this lightweight vase makes flower arrangement easy, fun, and meaningful, making your life or work easier and more meaningful. Very suitable for bookshelves, desks, windowsills, can be a good choice for small interior decoration, for home decoration, holiday and wedding decoration. Great gifts for Mother's Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas, housewarming, birthday or other holidays

【EXQUISITE GIFT】: This is a beautiful gift for a number of occasions. This design is perfect for a contemporary and modern look for your place. This ceramic piece would be a great housewarming gift wedding gift or anniversary gift. It's so versatile and can be used as a personalized vase or utensil holder.

Notes:
Vase only, other accessories demo in the picture is not included.
Due to the light and screen setting difference, the items color may be slightly different from the pictures.
Please allow 0.5 CM-1 CM slight dimension difference due to different manual measurement.
